quote: To reform one’s maxims is nothing: it is but to change the title of the book. To learn new habits is everything, for it is to reach the substance of life. Life is but a tissue of habits.
source: Henri-Frédéric Amiel, Amiel’s Journal, undated thought after the entry of 30 Dec. 1850 (trans. Mrs Humphry Ward, 1885)
note: From the undated thoughts printed after the entry of 30 December 1850 in Mrs Humphry Ward’s 1885 translation. The entry that follows is dated 16 February 1851 in the first edition and 17 February in the second, so the citation now names only the earlier date. The wording is the same in both editions.
